_about: Every radar- or lidar-guided powered landing with a published outcome that we could find, for the landing radar failure rate. class: a = the sensor failed to give valid data in descent (hardware or measurement); b = the sensor could not be used for another reason (an integration error); c = the sensor worked and the software rejected or misused its data; d = no sensor anomaly; u = unknown (no sensor record found; left out of the fit). confidence: opened = read in the primary document; excerpt = read in a quoted passage of it; secondary = a news or reference report quoting the source.

classes.a: sensor failure: counts as a landing radar failure
classes.b: integration error: a latent flaw (flown.py 'integration' prior), not a part failure
classes.c: software error: the flight software's job; not counted as a sensor failure
